office: the Gambia Immigration Department, the biometric form bought at an EcoBank branch on paying the fee
note: The biometric passport's fee, D5,100, its 32 pages and its five years' validity, from the Gambia Immigration Department's passport page (undated, read 2026-11-03), where the form is bought at an EcoBank branch on paying the fee. Until 2026-11-03 the fee stood on Gambiana's report of the Department's statement (22 April 2025: D100 for the form and D5,000 for the booklet, from 1 May 2025), and the validity was left unknown. The machine-readable passport, also issued at D3,100 with the same pages and validity, isn't written: the form tells passports apart only by age, pages and validity. Processing time and the fees at the enrolment points abroad are leads.

sources.title: Gambia Immigration Department, Passport (Passport Issuance; Passport Fees)
sources.said: Both passports in place currently contain 32 pages with both visible and invisible security futures embedded in them. The life span of the passports is five years’ validity period. The fees for the passports are determined by the government of the Gambia through the Ministry of Finance and implemented or enforce by the Ministry of Interior through the Gambia Immigration Department. Passport Fees Biometric Passport: D5100.00 Machine Readable Passport (MRP): D3100.00 Diplomatic Passport: Gratis Service Passport: Gratis Emergency Travel Certificate: D1100 ... For the biometric passport, the following procedures are involved: Applicant purchases and obtains a biometric passport form at any EcoBank branch upon paying the prescribed fees.
